title: 皐月賞の後に・これが勝負

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sakura Chiyono O wrings out the fruits of her training for her duel with Yaeno Muteki, but it's not enough.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Although it's just a single loss, it's a painful one, and Sakura Chiyono O realizes how frustrating it is to lose to a rival.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As Mejiro Ardan watches from the stands, she burns with eagerness, ready to give it her all in one of the few races she'll ever get to run—the Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Our next goal is the Japanese Derby—the most important race of all in Sakura Chiyono O's eyes.
